segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The prophet Isaiah pointed far ahead to a figure he called the root of Jesse — David's family tree, springing up fresh after it looked cut down.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: This one would stand as a banner, a signal, lifted up so the nations could find their way to Him. Not hidden. Raised for all to see.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people,

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Exiles in every direction, lifted out of every nation, brought home. The ensign is the invitation; the gathering is the answer.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The banner is raised — and the seeking ones, from every people, come home.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: A banner was raised so you could find your way. Seek Him, and you'll be gathered in.
